system.help: The system under study, labelled System: name or short description of the technical unit whose resources are being inventoried. Free text with no effect on any computation; an empty text clears the field.

cells.help: The resource grid: six categories as rows — substance (Substances), field (Fields), space (Space), time (Time), info (Information) and function (Function / energy) — by three system levels as columns — sub (Subsystem), sys (System) and super (Supersystem). Each of the 18 fields holds a note and a fill level. The grid is written as a whole with all 18 fields.

notes.help: The note on the field: which resource of this category exists on this level. Free text with no effect on any computation; an empty text clears the note.

status.help: The fill level of the field, how far the resource is used today: unknown (not yet investigated), unused (present but not exploited), partial (partly used) or full (fully used). Any other value is rejected.

cycleStatus.help: Advances the fill level of a field by one step, in the interface by clicking the round status button at the top right of the field: unknown, unused, partly used, fully used, then back to unknown. For a specific fill level there is an action that sets it directly.

params.catKey: The resource category, given by its key: substance (Substances), field (Fields), space (Space), time (Time), info (Information) or function (Function / energy). Any other key is rejected.
params.lvlKey: The system level, given by its key: sub (Subsystem), sys (System) or super (Supersystem). Any other key is rejected.
params.command: The command as one object with catKey and lvlKey.

setCellStatus.help: Sets the fill level of a field directly to a specific value: how far this resource is used today. In the interface the status button advances the fill level instead.

params.catKey: The resource category, given by its key: substance (Substances), field (Fields), space (Space), time (Time), info (Information) or function (Function / energy). Any other key is rejected.
params.lvlKey: The system level, given by its key: sub (Subsystem), sys (System) or super (Supersystem). Any other key is rejected.
params.status: The new fill level: unknown (not yet investigated), unused (present but not exploited), partial (partly used) or full (fully used). Any other value is rejected and leaves the state unchanged.
params.command: The command as one object with catKey, lvlKey and status.
